name: Ebony Loren with REBBY
description: The Moroccan Lounge Presents: Ebony Loren with REBBY [November 8, 2026 / Doors 6:30pm / $20 adv / $25 dos / All Ages] Ebony Loren is a 25-year-old singer-songwriter originally from Milwaukee, Wisconsin, currently based in Los Angeles. She has been releasing music since 2020, developing a sound rooted in acoustic pop with influences in R&B and jazz. In November 2025, she released her debut album, Work in Progress, a reflection of navigating her twenties, self-discovery, and the growing pains of adulthood. The album explores themes of nostalgia, imposter syndrome, overwhelm of busy adult life, and acknowledging your flaws while still finding self-love. Having built her fanbase organically, and largely independently, Ebony takes pride in creating music that feels personal, with a focus on connecting with listeners and making them feel seen.
